title: Talona's Art of Crafting
description: Talona's Art of Crafting is a Minecraft mod that adds recipes to things from vanilla Minecraft that do not have recipes such as nametags, saddles, and more.
body:
Lost Recipes is a Minecraft mod that adds Recipes to things that currently do not have recipes. The entire list of recipes in the mod are below aswell as the discord where you can follow any progress I make on this mod or future ones.

- Name Tag (Needs 1 String and 1 Paper)

![Name Tag Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e5de5aba5591aa4c1ab51a91d9fc069fe7ccf7e_0.webp)

- Chainmail Armor (Needs 24 Chains)

![Chainmail Helmet Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59144175728b327691e13455def7eebff2a559b0.png)
![Chainmail Chestplate Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/336a16859c019b811a044b128dc5b908004a8b53.png)
![Chainmail Leggings Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9767c39513ae6dafa74e3b9de83721e03d875005.png)
![Chainmail Boots Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce5d3f822cc4d88e6050c9afc9844dee847d0a4c.png)

- Saddle (Needs 5 Leather, 1 Iron Ingot, 1 String)

![Saddle Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c0ea0ca52964f71c2d55d91914b27715f790b22.png)

- Horse Armor (Needs 1 String, Then EITHER 5 Leather, Iron, Gold, Or Diamond)

![Leather Horse Armor Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d39aa5ee37c0bebe0e6502d6c727c4bf73709fe.png)
![Iron Horse Armor Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ade69134c56b8fa2a00def3abddd6751dd990a7_0.webp)
![Gold Horse Armor Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b13ab0dfbb98a616d036ab927ec214eea741f41b.png)
![Diamond Horse Armor Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b5049be3d9777afdf2933b86be18748d79088a2.png)

- Enchanted Golden Apple (Needs 8 Blocks Of Gold, 1 Apple)

![Enchanted Golden Apple Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81124c2aff2afd5b8a0a0add4cb51cca7e7b142e.png)

- Crying Obsidian (Needs 1 Obsidian, 1 Water Bucket)

![Crying Obsidian Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2277d44452f1f7091db7925f5927edc0158bf954_0.webp)

- Cobweb (Needs 5 String)

![Cobweb Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9835470badd84c05834edc0d913cce84de18ecb5_0.webp)

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/Sa36awN6T3
